POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/judge/backtest Preview draft judge grading on one recorded iteration
GET /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/decision-summary Get a run's decision summary
GET /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/compare Compare a run against a baseline
GET /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/iterations/{iterationId}/steps Get an iteration's step results
POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun Rerun a run's failed cases
GET /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/stage-analytics Get one run's stage analytics
GET /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/gate Get one run's suite quality-gate report
PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account} Upload tokens to a server account
PATCH /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account} Rename a server account or make it the default
GET /organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget Read the organization's spend budget
PUT /organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget Set the organization's spend budget
DELETE /organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget Remove the organization's spend budget
POST /organizations/{organizationId}/eval-check-repos Run an eval suite on a repository's pull requests
POST /projects/{projectId}/servers Save a server into a project
POST /projects/{projectId}/model-leases Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference
POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/insights Request insights for an eval run
POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/judge Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge
POST /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/readiness-runs/claude Start a Claude directory-readiness run
POST /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/readiness-runs/openai Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run
POST /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/readiness-runs/muse Start a Muse connector readiness run
POST /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/conformance-runs Start a persisted conformance run
GET /registry/directory-servers Search the scraped MCP directories
GET /projects/{projectId}/registry/servers List curated and org registry cards
